purpose: Test whether the representation-robust Voynich ED1-chain-lift residual is already implied by frozen legacy generator mechanisms, without fitting any mechanism to chain lift.

upstream.representation_qualification: ed1_chain_lift was a positive shared residual in at least 7/9 sections under RF_MEMBER, STA_FAMILY and AAA_CONNECTED. Legacy generators are scored in their native EVA-like output space; no invented EVA-to-STA conversion is permitted.

target.segmentation: physical transcription line; drawing/uncertain material excluded by alphabetic-token cleaning

primary_metric.name: ed1_chain_lift
primary_metric.definition: P(ED1 at transition i+1 | ED1 at transition i) - P(ED1 at an adjacent transition), computed only within lines; exact-equal pairs are not ED1.

GPRIME.mechanism: frequency-weighted global type distribution; each page split into 64-token regions; frequency-weighted anchor plus its ED1 radius-1 ball boosted x8; iid draws within region; would-be adjacent exact doubles converted to an ED1 neighbour with probability .186; independently replace current token by an ED1 neighbour of predecessor with probability .0009.

Q57B.status: exact replay only if complete archived dependency stack is available
Q57B.rule: If q56_injective_anonymous_realiser.py is unavailable, record NOT_EXACTLY_REPLAYABLE and do not substitute a later generator.

within_line_shuffle.preserves: exact token multiset and line lengths
within_line_shuffle.purpose: destroy transition ordering while retaining each line inventory

line_order_shuffle.expected: ed1_chain_lift exactly invariant up to floating point

adjudication.model_match: same sign as target AND abs(model_median/target - 1) <= 0.25 AND model_median exceeds its pooled within-line-shuffle null by z>=2
adjudication.model_partial: same sign as target AND abs(model_median/target - 1) <= 0.50 but full match fails
primary_rules: CHAIN_LIFT_ALREADY_IMPLIED_BY_LEGACY_MECHANISM if GPRIME or TIMM_DEFAULT is MODEL_MATCH
CHAIN_LIFT_NEW_MECHANISTIC_GAP_WITHIN_TESTED_LEGACY_ARMS if neither GPRIME nor TIMM_DEFAULT is MODEL_MATCH
Q57B absence cannot by itself trigger or prevent either verdict and must be disclosed
adjudication.ablation_interpretation: Ablations are causal diagnostics only and cannot be selected as the winning legacy mechanism.

prohibitions: No fitting or parameter search against ed1_chain_lift
No target-dependent choice among generator variants
No replacement of an unrecoverable Q57b dependency with a later generator
No semantic interpretation from a chain-lift match
